newsitem.title: LATVIA: Unibanka in demand on more active Latvian bourse.
newsitem.headline: Unibanka in demand on more active Latvian bourse.

text.p: Latvian shares doubled volume to 84,000 lats from 44,000 lats on Tuesday and Unibanka was well traded, dealers said.
The bourse index rose .11 points to 384 and the Rietumu index was unchanged at 152.1.

Unibanka was by far the most active stock on the otherwise sluggish market, which has been laid low by summer and competition from the local debt market and privatisation vouchers, which are more popular among investors.
It stood out in trade of 54,600 lats at the steady price of 3.34 lats.
"Unibanka looks like a good buy at that price, and it seems some long-term investors may have bought in the hope that when the market picks up, it will almost certainly rise," said one dealer.
Kaija Fish cannery rebounded four percent after losing six percent on Monday, rising to 2.10 lats from 2.02 lats in trade of 2,100 lats.
"Kaija fell simply fell too far for no apparent reason," said one dealer.
On the secondary list, Valmiera Glassfibre was active at 7,100 lats as its price edged up to 1.42 lats from 1.40 lats.
